column3: Protected has a calmer new look: a band of light fills the ring around a Protected card, and the shards around a Protected player's health gem light up one by one.
If the card tables have a mistake, the game now says what it is and where, instead of failing to load or blaming old files.
The menu shows which update you have; tap it to see what changed.|Keyboard players can scroll the What's new list and the battle log, and screen readers announce the computer thinking.

Save code in Settings: copy your progress and load it on another device.|If the game hits a problem, a window offers a bug report to copy and send.|Plays offline after one visit, and can be added to a phone's home screen.|The computer's surprise moves no longer change a match's luck.
The worlds are now broad: Simple, Wild, Undead, Mortal and Cyber, with new tribes.|Each champion leads a tribe.
Phones run cooler: heavy effects start off on touch screens, and looping effects rest when nothing is happening.

Settings: turn heavy effects on or off.|The table redraws faster.|Card stories for all 113 cards, unlocked the first time you play each card.|A Trophy case, and scenes in the Campaign.|Turn history in the battle log.|Each deck shows its record and average cost.
A new start menu: Campaign, Quick Match and Two Players.|Champions speak in every match.|Deck mastery titles.

Cards travel across the table, characters are bigger, and the computer's turns are easier to follow.|Spots light up while you place a card.|Big hits flash the edges of the screen.|Fixed: passing in the Draw phase skipped your draw.
The Shattered Crystal look.|Random events.|Bigger card art, and bigger tap areas on phones.
The deck builder.|The Crystal Altar board.|Health changes colour as it drops.
